newsitem.title: NORWAY: Scancem in power deal with Vattenfall.
newsitem.headline: Scancem in power deal with Vattenfall.

text.p: Nordic cement and building materials group Scancem AB said on Thursday it had entered a long-term supply agreement with Swedish power company Vattenfall AS.
The deal, worth about 200 million Norwegian crowns, will secure electricity supplies for Scancem's Norwegian activities until 2000, the company said in a statement.
Vattenfall already delivers power to Scancem's Swedish activities.
Scancem's largest shareholders are Norway's Aker ASA and Sweden's Skanska AB with 33 percent each.
